text: For long multiline responses, LineReader yields to the event loop after 1000 lines. The older spinEventLoopUntilEmpty path could stall POP3 LIST or UIDL processing until a server timeout. Making read async also required callers to handle resulting promise failures.
title: Yield large POP3 and NNTP line responses without nested event loops
